questions.title: Vector Space Axioms
questions.description: Determine whether the given set forms a vector space.
questions.content: Is the set of all 2×2 matrices with determinant 0 a vector space over ℝ? Justify your answer.
questions.correctAnswer: No. It is not closed under addition — the sum of two singular matrices can be non-singular.

questions.title: Linear Independence
questions.description: Check independence of a set of vectors.
questions.content: Are the vectors (1,2,3), (2,4,6), (0,1,0) linearly independent in ℝ³?
questions.correctAnswer: No. The second vector is 2× the first, so the set is linearly dependent.

questions.title: Basis and Dimension
questions.description: Find a basis for the given subspace.
questions.content: Find a basis for the null space of A = [[1,2,-1],[2,4,-2]].

questions.title: Rank of a Matrix
questions.content: Compute the rank of the matrix [[1,0,1],[0,1,1],[1,1,2]].
questions.correctAnswer: Rank = 2 (third row is the sum of the first two).

questions.title: Change of Basis
questions.description: Express a vector in a new basis.
questions.content: Given B = {(1,1),(1,-1)}, write (3,1) in coordinates relative to B.

questions.title: Limit Evaluation
questions.content: Evaluate lim(x→0) sin(3x)/x.
questions.correctAnswer: 3, by the standard limit sin(kx)/x → k.

questions.title: Continuity
questions.content: Is f(x) = |x|/x continuous at x = 0?
questions.correctAnswer: No, f has a jump discontinuity at 0 (left limit -1, right limit +1).

questions.title: Differentiation
questions.content: Compute the derivative of f(x) = x²·ln(x).

questions.title: Extrema
questions.content: Find the local extrema of f(x) = x³ - 3x.
questions.correctAnswer: Local max at x = -1 (value 2), local min at x = 1 (value -2).

questions.title: Definite Integral
questions.content: Compute ∫₀¹ (2x + 1) dx.
questions.correctAnswer: 2, since the antiderivative x² + x evaluated from 0 to 1 gives 2.

questions.title: Binary Search Tree
questions.content: Insert 5,3,8,1,4 into an empty BST. What is the in-order traversal?
questions.correctAnswer: 1,3,4,5,8 — in-order traversal of a BST yields sorted order.

questions.title: AVL Rotation
questions.content: Which rotation restores balance after inserting 1,2,3 in order?
questions.correctAnswer: A single left rotation at the root.

questions.title: Hashing
questions.content: With linear probing and table size 7, where does key 10 go if slot 3 is taken?
questions.correctAnswer: Slot 4 (10 mod 7 = 3, probe to the next open slot).
